Looking for the most twisted, disturbing, intense and unforgettable movies currently streaming on Netflix? In this video, I’m highlighting a lineup of newly added Netflix movies that push boundaries, get under your skin, and deliver the kind of dark, graphic, shocking, or psychologically extreme stories you don’t forget five minutes after the credits roll.

These are not just random disturbing movies for shock value. I’m focusing on movies that are worth watching because they’re well-made, gripping, strange, brutal, suspenseful, or completely unhinged in ways that make them stand out from the usual Netflix slop.

Whether you’re into dark thrillers, graphic horror, twisted crime stories, psychological nightmares, or just movies that make you say, “I can’t believe Netflix has this,” this list should give you plenty to add
